messages.subject: Restructuring & Finance team dinner - Thurs 5 March
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi all,

Now that a few big matters are wrapping up, the team dinner is booked for Thursday 5 March, 7:30pm at Mistral on Old Broad Street. Please let me know any dietary requirements by 28 February. Partners are kindly covering it.

Hope you can all make it!
Donna
